lines.en: - Can you throw that in the trash can?
- I was just here, like, three weeks ago for your wedding.
- Well, I always think April's gonna clean up.
- We were checking to see if the fire alarm worked.
- Well, there were no bed bugs.
I'm gonna go buy a bed.
- I'm sorry. Are you eating turkey chili off of a frisbee?
- What have you got against turkey chili for breakfast?
- What have you guys got against washing dishes?
- We don't have any dishes, okay?
Burley took them all when he left.
Now I bet you feel like a jerk.
Okay, I might need to not stay here anymore.
We already spent your money on a new Xbox 360
and more frisbees to eat off of.
We're gonna clean this place up, okay?
And then I'm going to teach you how to be adults.
- Okay, so you always separate your lights from your darks.
- And then you get your laundry deter...
You wash your clothes in bubble bath?
- Eh, bubble bath, clothes, soap, same thing.
- Well, they both make bubbles, so...
- All right, we need to do some basic organization.
Where do you put your bills when they come?
- I read the magazines and give the rest to Andy.
- Which I organize into a pile or stack
that I put into the freezer.
- Okay, you have to pay these.
- Okay, here is a list of errands
and things that human adults need.
Also, I'm giving you an advance on next month's rent,
and I want you guys to go to Bed Bath & Beyond
and buy everything on that list.
- Or we could buy a Wii.
- I don't know, I don't know, man.
Why don't you just do it?
I have total faith in you.
There's like a 30% chance they'll both die.
- Oh my God, they have all the "as seen on TV" stuff.
- Shake weight, iron gym, miracle hand repair,
big top cookie, pillow bites, slap chop.
- Oh my God, go for it.
Grab everything that we've seen it on TV,
put it in this cart right now.
I am gonna get so buffed.
- Oh my God, a marshmallow shooter!
- Wait, what about the magic pull-up?
We didn't get a single thing that Ben told us to.
I don't think that's on the list.
But I also kinda want my own fork.
Just cause you eat really slow.
Which is cute, but also super annoying.
And I don't wanna buy all this stupid boring adult stuff
Yes, we're gonna get a dish rack and shower curtains
But if you think for one second I'm not also gonna get
that marshmallow shooter so that I can shoot you in the face
then you're the dumbest woman I know.
